senses.gloss: f. (√רע, h. q. v.) [the brittle] land, earth, ground, field.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 16:5">Targ. Y. Gen. XVI, 5</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 29a:11">B. Bath. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>חדא א׳</he> one field; v. <cite ref="B00009"><he>בָּאגָא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bekhorot 25b">Bekh. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דחשוכא</he> a land of darkness (Babylon); a. fr.—
Sabb. 65ᵃ בת א׳ (a Chaldaic adaptation of ποδάγρα, podagra) gout, sore on the toes.—עמא דא׳ = עם הארץ, v. אֶרֶץ.—Pl. אַרְעָן, אַרְעָאן, אַרְעיָּין.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 28:8">Targ. Jer. XXVIII, 8</cite> Levita, Targ. II Esth. IV, 1. Usu. <he>אַרְעָתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 26:3">Targ. Gen. XXVI, 3</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 7a">B. Kam. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>הוקר א׳</he>, <he>הוזל א׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="G00173"><he>זול</he></cite>, sub. <cite ref="D00891"><he>דמי</he></cite>) land fell, rose in price. V. <he>לְאַרַע</he>.
